This enables probabilistic tracking of arXiv submissions through Bayesian belief updates. The integrity catch identifies mismatches between tracker records and actual ledger content, triggering a derived kernel that flags inconsistencies. When a REJECT verdict is detected, it activates a replacement protocol that ensures continuity of evaluation. These mechanisms form a closed-loop system where parsing errors propagate into integrity checks, which in turn drive corrective actions. The failure mode occurs when format variance exceeds parser tolerance or when ledger data is not properly synchronized with tracker entries.
